```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(aod)
```
```{r}
msleep <- glimpse(msleep)
storms <- storms
lizards <- lizards
```

# Mammals sleep dataset

## Q1: Use filter() to subset msleep to only animals who are awake for at least 12 hours of the day.

```{r}
half_day_msleep <- msleep |> 
  filter(awake >= 12) |> 
  select(awake, everything())
half_day_msleep
```
## Q2: Use mutate() to create a new column called percent_day_awake that gives the percentage of the day that each species spends awake. Use select() with everything() at the end to verify your calculation.

```{r}
msleep |> 
  mutate(percent_day_awake = awake/24 * 100) |> 
  select(percent_day_awake, awake, everything())
```

# Storm tracks data

## Q3: Use group_by() and summarize() to calculate the number of storms per year.

```{r}
storms |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarise(num_storms = n())
```

## Q4: Use filter() to subset storms to only storms with wind speeds greater than 50 knots, then use arrange() to sort by wind descending.

```{r}
storms |> 
  filter(wind > 50) |> 
  arrange(desc(wind)) |>  
  select(wind, everything())
```

# A Comparison of Site Preferences of Two Species of Lizards

## Q5: Determine which Site and Diameter combination has the highest total grahami.

```{r}
lizards |> 
  group_by(Site, Diameter) |> 
  summarise(highest_total_grahami = sum(grahami)) |> 
  arrange(desc(highest_total_grahami))
```
